newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health names new chairman.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc said Malik Hasan was named chairman and chief executive, replacing Daniel Crowley, who resigned as chairman effective Thursday.
Hasan was president and CEO of Foundation. Jay Gellert, executive vice president and chief operating officer, was named president and COO, the company said.
Crowley would remain on the board and would serve as a consultant to the company for three years, it said.

Crowley was chairman, president and CEO of Foundation Health Corp and became chairman of Foundation Health Systems in April 1997 when it was formed by the merger of Foundation and Health Systems International Inc, the company said.
Hasan was chairman and CEO of HSI prior to the merger and under the agreement was scheduled to succeed Crowley as chairman one year after the merger, it said.
Earlier Thursday, Foundation, the country's fourth-biggest managed care company, said it agreed to buy Physicians Health Services for about $280 million cash.
